prose: Axios reports that OpenAI is urging the United States to lead the creation of global safety standards for frontier AI systems, timing the push around the US-China diplomatic track and Sam Altman's address at the UN. The proposal lands as Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the US and China agreed to set up an AI dialogue, giving OpenAI's standards pitch a bilateral opening.
The move positions OpenAI as a willing partner for regulation of the most capable models, aligning its public safety-standards message with the administration's engagement with Beijing on AI risk.
highlights: OpenAI urges the US to lead global frontier-safety standards for AI
Timing: Sam Altman's UN address and the newly announced US-China AI dialogue
Comes as Treasury Secretary Bessent confirms the US and China agreed to set up an AI dialogue
Positions OpenAI as supportive of standards for the most capable systems
